title: Iress V4 Common Request Header
description: Logical view of the Header block carried by every V4 method. The actual SOAP is Document/Literal — elements are flattened into the message rather than wrapped in a complex type.

SessionKey.description: Iress session token (for Iress Pro / WebAdmin).

ServiceSessionKey.description: Service session token (for IOS+ / IPS / FIX+).

WaitForResponse.description: If false, server returns immediately with StatusCode=1.

PageSize.description: Max rows per page. Server may cap per method.

RequestID.description: GUID. Unique per active request. Used for paging and updates.

Updates.description: If true, the request subscribes to updates after the snapshot.

PagingBookmark.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's response.
